goal: Implement Slice S5 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): runtime/unattended owns the one production Batch child Kernel port; hosts inject only advanceTask; git operations go through BatchRunnerGitPort alone. Batch preflight decisions do not change.

acceptance.assertion: Per D5 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U1, E6): one production child Kernel port in runtime/unattended provides enrollTask (through the single Enrollment entry), projectTask, ownsTaskClaim and validateBatchAuthorization; a host passes only advanceTask. Positive: a child enrolls, projects and is recognised as owned. Negative: a changed recovery projection is refused with 'Kernel recovery projection changed'. Bound: resume ownership is recognised for a claim held by the same Batch. Agreed seams: tests/unattended-batch-run.test.ts, tests/unattended-contracts.test.ts.

Per D5 and invariant I5 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: BatchRunnerKernelPort has no git members and the runner has no git fallback chain. Positive: with no git port injected the runner uses createDefaultBatchGitPort. Negative: an injected BatchRunnerGitPort fully replaces the default and no default git operation runs. Bound: Partial<BatchRunnerKernelPort> overrides still apply to the remaining members. Agreed seams: tests/unattended-batch-run.test.ts, tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts.

Per D5 and invariant I4 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: Pi advanceTask still returns agent_params from advancePiTask and Claude advanceTask still goes through coordinator.advance; gates, authorization and resume behave as before. Existing assertions in the named suites are not weakened. Agreed seams: tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
